name: Valentina Carrasco
bio:
Valentina's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, restoring classic cars in her grandfather's Santiago workshop. She quickly discovered a passion for the intricate details of composite materials and their potential for pushing performance limits. An apprenticeship at a local engineering firm led to her specializing in carbon fiber fabrication, eventually catching the eye of Prema Racing scouts.

Valentina's approach as a composite technician is characterized by meticulous precision and a constant search for improvement. She believes in a holistic view of the car, understanding how each component interacts to achieve optimal performance. She's earned a reputation for her innovative repair techniques, often finding solutions others miss, and her dedication to sharing her knowledge with junior team members. Her experience and big-picture thinking make her a valuable asset in developing cutting-edge aerodynamic components.

What sets Valentina apart is her ability to blend technical expertise with a deep understanding of the human element. She thrives on collaboration, always ready to mentor and support her colleagues. Her loyalty to Prema Racing is unwavering, a testament to her strong sense of teamwork and commitment to excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and usually tied up in a practical bun.
physical.description: A strong, athletic build complements her focused, intense stare.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against the desk when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while working on complex repairs.
